newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 7-month exports up to $11.277 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 7-month exports up to $11.277 bln.

text.p: Philippine merchandise exports in the first seven months of the year rose by 17.3 percent to $11.277 billion from $9.615 billion in the same 1995 period, the government's National Statistics Office said on Wednesday.
The NSO said in a statement that export receipts for July alone were up 6.3 percent to $1.694 billion from $1.593 billion in the same month last year.
Electronics and electronics components remained the country's top export earner in July at $632.12 million, up from the year-ago $506.29 million.
Clothing and accessories sector dropped by 17.3 percent to $221.81 million from $268.13 million.
Sugar export revenues leapt to $54.23 million from $8.74 million while coconut oil was down 7.9 percent to $45.21 million from $49.08 million.
